name: codex-native-memory
description: Local cross-session memory for Codex Desktop and Codex CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Search and summarize local Codex conversations.
interface.longDescription: Keeps Codex as the primary coding AI, imports Codex and attached external AI transcripts into local SQLite, exposes cross-session search through MCP, and can summarize with the local Codex CLI.
interface.defaultPrompt: Bootstrap my Codex project memory, then use relevant context before answering.
